visual_review.notes: Attack and cast are retakes with 128 px of headroom: the first takes raised the sabre out of the top of the video. Attack skips three frames where the blade tip still touches the top edge (video 21-23) and the return where the sabre thins into a straight greenish rod (78-86). Cast skips the turn where the buckler goes black and the sabre seems to pass out of it (10-16), so the low guard snaps up into the salute. Death skips the fall frames where the hair carries green fringes (64-66). Idle, move, hit and defend are the first takes. Re-matted 2026-10-14 with the green-plate spill limit: the green rims on thin and blurred edges are gone, with the same frames, timing, anchor and scale.
